entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A frogfolk hedgewitch from Bloomburrow, minor weaver and augur, and member of Mabel's party.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the party Helga joined.

entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: King of Fountainport who taught Helga and stole Maha's egg to train the infant Calamity Beast.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: Glarb's thief, whom Helga located with augury.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: A Calamity Beast who attacked Pondside; she was appeased when Mabel returned her egg.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker turned into an otterfolk who was looking for Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker believed to be on Bloomburrow in the shape of a fox.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: A frogfolk village where Helga was raised, destroyed in Maha's attack.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: Town where Helga warned Mabel and later chose to stay.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: City attacked by the Flood Gar.

entities.name: Flood Gar
entities.description: A Calamity Beast that attacked Three Tree City.

events.summary: Helga escaped Pondside when Maha attacked it and warned Mabel and the people of Goodhill about the Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: Helga escaped Pondside when it was attacked by Maha around 4564 AR .

events.summary: Helga joined Mabel's party, along with Finneas, Gev, Hugs and Zoraline, to go to Pondside.
events.quote: Helga volunteered to accompany her because she wanted to see what happened to her homeland.

events.summary: Helga found her home at Pondside utterly destroyed.
events.quote: Helga was dismayed to find that it was utterly destroyed.

events.summary: Helga made a staircase of water droplets so Mabel could attack skeletal birdfolk.
events.quote: Helga used one of her cantrips to make a staircase of water droplets so that Mabel could attack skeletal birdfolk .

events.summary: In Three Tree City Helga met Ral Zarek and told him of her vision of Jace; the Flood Gar then swept the party downstream.
events.quote: Shortly afterward, the city was attacked by the Flood Gar , and the party was swept downstream.

events.summary: Helga located Cruelclaw with augury for the first time intentionally, learning he had gone to Fountainport.
events.quote: Helga located Cruelclaw with her augury, performing augury for the first time intentionally.

events.summary: Glarb revealed he caused the Calamity Beasts' rampage by stealing Maha's egg and set Cruelclaw and mercenaries on the party.
events.quote: he revealed that he was the cause of the Calamity Beasts' rampage, as he had stolen Maha's egg.

events.summary: Maha appeared and Mabel appeased her by returning her egg.
events.quote: whom Mabel appeased by returning her egg

events.summary: Helga stayed in Goodhill and spoke a prophecy in a trance.
events.quote: Helga decided to stay there rather than go to Haymeadow or Three Tree City.

relations.quote: her time learning under King Glarb

relations.note: Sent mercenaries to fight her party.
relations.quote: he summoned Cruelclaw and other mercenaries to fight Mabel's party off
he summoned Cruelclaw and other mercenaries
